data.name: Ikhtisaas
data.gender_notes: Ikhtisaas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: To hold, to grasp, to possess
data.long_meaning: Originated from the Arabic verb 'Ikhtasasa', meaning to hold, to grasp, to possess. It is also a term in Islamic law referring to the right of a person to retain ownership of an acquired property or asset. The name Ikhtisaas carries the meaning “To hold, to grasp, to possess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ikhtisaas usually hope their child will grow to embody to hold, to grasp, to possess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To possess the inner strength and wisdom to protect and preserve one's values and beliefs.
data.etymology: Ikhtisaas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To hold, to grasp, to possess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikhtisaas total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.long_meaning: اختصاص هو مصدر عربي يعني الحصول على شيء ما أو الاستيلاء عليه، ويُستخدم في السياق الإسلامي لوصف الحصول على العلم أو الفضيلة، ويمكن رؤيته في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة حيث يُشير إلى اختصاص الله بالرحمة والمغفرة

in_english.name: Ikhtisaas
in_english.long_meaning: Ikhtisaas is an Arabic root word meaning acquiring or obtaining something, and in Islamic context, it refers to acquiring knowledge or virtue, and can be seen in the Quran in Surah Al-Fatihah where it hints at Allah's acquisition of mercy and forgiveness

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic finance and economic systems, 'Ikhtisaas' signifies the concept of attacking poverty through profit and loss sharing. It is a key principle in Islamic to practice social responsibility in business transactions. This is achieved by investing in businesses that not only generate profits, but also create opportunities for employment, education, and social development. It is a practical implementation of the Islamic principle of 'Maqasid al-Shariah' or the ultimate objectives of Islamic law, which aims to protect the interests of individuals and society as a whole.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, 'Ikhtisaas' represents the idea of possessing and holding onto knowledge, wisdom, and faith. It is a reminder for Muslims to value and cultivate their relationship with Allah through regular prayer, recitation of the Quran, and continuous learning and reflection. The term also encapsulates the idea of being mindful and appreciative of the blessings we have in life, and striving to make the best use of them to serve and please Allah. Through this perspective, 'Ikhtisaas' cultivates a sense of gratitude, contentment, and a deep appreciation for the blessings of God.
